notes: Converted from IBM AML HI-Small (Kaggle ealtman2019/ibm-transactions-for-anti-money-laundering-aml). Labels are laundering typologies, not scam reports. Amounts are approximate MYR via a static FX table. receiver_account_age_days and onward_young_receiver_share are unavailable. balance_drain_ratio is a proxy (amount / max(7-day inflow, 10 x typical)). pass-through window 30 min.
